description: This file defines the CDPSession class that manages Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) sessions within the Playwright testing framework. It provides methods for sending commands and handling session events.

classes.name: CDPSession
classes.description: Represents a Chrome DevTools Protocol session, allowing communication with a browser's internals.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a CDPSession instance from a channel object.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new CDPSession with parent, type, guid, and initializer.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command to the CDP session and returns the result.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the session from the browser.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static method to obtain a CDPSession instance from a channel object.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a protocol command over the CDP session.
